🗳️ الجمعة ١٨ ديسمبر موعدنا في نادي طنطا الرياضي
صوتي لقائمة المهندس حسين داود .. وانت معانا؟
تاريخ نحترمه .. ومستقبل نصنعه 💛💙
اتعرّف على المرشحين الـ١٢ وبرنامج القائمة هنا 👇
{url}
📣 وتابع الحملة الرسمية على فيسبوك:
https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61596208629223

copyright.ar: © ٢٠٢٦ قائمة المهندس حسين داود. جميع الحقوق محفوظة.

todo: videos: 24 Nov, 8 of the 12 interviews in (Google Drive folder from Ahmed, files named after the candidates): Sedky, Fathy Selim, El-Sharkawy, Sweilem, Karim, Ashoush, El-Menshawy, Attia. Vertical phone videos (1080x1920), re-encoded to 720x1280 H.264 (3.5–9 MB each, faststart) in clients/tantasportsclubelections/public/videos/<slug>.mp4 (live build only); each plays on its profile (candidates[].interview, portrait: a 9:16 window, cover = the designed poster standing up, media/<slug>-poster-tall.jpg, tools/video-posters.mjs); the home and file-page cards link there with a play button. Still missing: Waleed Afify, Khaled Hamza, Mohamed Mabrouk: they keep «قريبًا». Cloudflare Pages takes files up to 25 MB. 24 Nov: Fathy Selim's and Mohamed Sedky's videos taken down at Ahmed's request (files deleted; back to «قريبًا»); the other six stay. 25 Nov: on a profile the header's photo is the player (CandidateHero video prop): a gold pulsing play button two thirds of the way down the arch (on the chest, clear of the face; 25 Nov), and pressed, the video plays inside the same arch (trimmed to it), tap to pause, a gold progress bar above the ribbon, the photo back at the end; no separate player below. Phones: compact words so the photo fits the first screen. 26 Nov: the leader's two videos in (Drive folder from Ahmed): «…2» is his profile video (vertical, public/videos/hussein-dawood.mp4, 5 MB, plays in his header's arch), the other is his word on the home page (landscape 1920x1080, 2:46, re-encoded to 1280x720 at about 0.8 Mbps: public/videos/hussein-dawood-word.mp4, 17 MB; home.leader.video, cover media/hussein-dawood-poster.jpg). The same folder has a «صور» subfolder with five photos (IMG_7531–7537), not used.
vision page (/vision/, template vision, elections.json vision): Ahmed's text, three typos fixed (ثقفي، مساحات الخضراء، المهارت); linked from the home hero only.

program files: seven (المالي والحوكمة، التطوير، الاستثمار والتسويق، الطبي، التحول الرقمي، الأمني والإداري، الرياضي). 21 Nov: each file page shows its plan (elections.json files[].plan, FilePlan.astro): text word for word from seven candidates' papers (22 Nov: + marketing and development), no names, sorted by file (source and choices: program-files-text.md). Still missing: the investment half of «الاستثمار والتسويق» and a digital paper (its 3 points come from other papers). The one-line taglines are ours (placeholders: confirm). The old /files/services and /files/culture redirect to /files/. File leads (elections.json files[].leads; on the file cards and under each file page's title), from the client's strategy sheet «الرؤية الاستراتيجية لنادي طنطا 2026–2030» (21 Nov): finance Afify; development Attia; investment Abu El-Azm and Ashoush; medical Mabrouk; digital Sweilem; security Sedky and El-Sharkawy; sports Selim, Hamza and El-Menshawy. The sheet titles two files «المالية والحوكمة» and «الأمن والإداري»; the site keeps the client's earlier titles (المالي والحوكمة، الأمني والإداري): confirm.
election: Friday 18 December 2026 at 9:00 AM Cairo time (from Ahmed). The countdown runs to that moment; from then the day's message shows.
membership number: no format rule since 26 Nov (Ahmed's call): any text up to 40 characters, required; Arabic digits are turned into Latin ones.

social: Facebook only, the campaign page https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61596208629223 (short form of its /people/… address). It is in the footer, the search data (sameAs) and every WhatsApp message (support.share.messages and headerCta.text), always AFTER the site link: WhatsApp builds the preview from the first link, so the preview stays the website's.

support page: no sign-up any more (Ahmed's call). It is a WhatsApp share kit (elections.json support.share: three ready messages linking to the home page, a live chat preview, share and copy buttons); the link preview is media/share.jpg, made by tools/share-card.mjs. Complaints: for now the form opens WhatsApp to 01000083751 with the message written (elections.json complaints.whatsapp; the member presses Send, photos go in the chat). Automatic sending through the WhatsApp Cloud API (phase B) was cancelled on 22 Nov: the client is happy with the hand-off (and the QR code on computers), so api.mode stays demo.
El-Sharkawy (اللواء مصطفى الشرقاوي; first read from the poster as الشمقاوي; the old /team/mostafa-el-shamkawy/ redirects): CV in (18 Nov; address, phone and email left out).

leader: CV in, age shown (51, from his CV; Ahmed's call). Company cards: StyleHome, Kleek, Tanta Modern School, Syncology (Friends taken off the cards by Ahmed; it stays in the bio). Logos from the media agent. Each card links to the company's site (elections.json url): stylehome-egypt.com, kleekdevelopments.com, tms-egypt.com, syncology.tech.
seats: from the campaign poster (via the media agent). Ballot numbers are the official ones (the club's candidate lists, numbered per seat), set 18 Nov.
names: Fathy Selim is د. (Ahmed, matching the poster; his bio keeps his popular name كابتن فتحي سليم); the poster spells the leader 'داود'.

photos: client photos cut out by the media agent. 18 Nov: Ahmed caught a mix-up: the photo shown as Mabrouk was Karim Abu El-Azm (now Karim's card), and the grey-suit photo shown as Karim is nobody on the list (removed). The three photos shown as El-Sharkawy were someone else too (removed). Mabrouk and El-Sharkawy are cut out of the stadium poster (the only source): closer head-and-shoulders framing, real pixels only; neighbours' sleeves removed (media agent, second pass), a small jaw seam on El-Sharkawy blended. Crest: the media agent's 3D version (v2, 18 Nov) (crest.webp with shadow on blue: hero, page bands, ballot card, share cards; logo.webp without shadow: header, favicon, schema logo). The club's original file would still be the best source. 23 Nov: Karim Abu El-Azm's individual card replaced from a new studio photo (media agent; nudged 24px down to line up with the others); team photos unchanged. Video posters recoloured to navy and gold (tools/video-posters.mjs). 24 Nov: Mohamed Attia's individual card replaced from a new studio photo (media agent, 10ac24c); team photos unchanged.

seo: Google Search Console is verified by DNS (TXT record in Cloudflare, so seo.googleSiteVerification stays empty) and /sitemap.xml is submitted. Cloudflare Web Analytics is on. The election's place carries the club's street address, postcode and map point (from the club's site tantasc.net and OpenStreetMap).

design: 20 Nov, the client's agent's design applied to every page hero (navy #15396A, gold #D2A24C, cream #FAF6EF; palette royal-blue keeps its name because the live build selects it): gold ribbons (GoldWave), the club gate pale on the left (list.backdrop, club-gate.webp: the media agent's cleaned and 4x enhanced photo, 19 Nov, ATM and cars removed, left wing rebuilt from the right), gold pill, the leader's name in gold (hero.titleAccent), hero buttons as cards with gold icon tabs (hero.actions[].icon). Spotlights, roof lines and the brass gate kept. Link previews remade in navy and gold: media/share.jpg (tools/share-card.mjs) and each candidate's <slug>-share.jpg (tools/candidate-share-cards.mjs).

strategy page (/strategy/, template strategy, elections.json strategy, 24 Nov): «رؤيتنا الاستراتيجية», the leader's strategic vision as a plan (FilePlan with project sections: scope, components, location, revenue, funding tinted gold). In the menu (nav 2) and as the leader section's second button on the home page. Text as Ahmed sent it, digits Arabic; light fixes only: spelling (علي→على، مغطاه→مغطاة، العير→غير، ذو الهمم→ذوي الهمم، اللازمه→اللازمة…), «ميزانًا»→«ميزانين», «عمل يمكن استخدامه» read as «عمل مسار يمكن استخدامه», the unnumbered «التطوير المعماري للمشروع بالكامل» placed seventh (the text skips from سادسًا to ثامنًا). Ours: the first part's title «مشروعات تطوير النادي وتنمية موارده» and the band's line «الرؤية الاستراتيجية لنادي طنطا ٢٠٢٦–٢٠٣٠» (from the client's strategy sheet): confirm.

flyer QR (25 Nov): tools/flyer-qr.mjs makes the printed QR code to the website (qr-code.svg, .pdf 10 cm, .png 3000 px; not kept in the repo, rerun the tool): navy on white, dark gold eye centres, the crest in the middle, level H. Tested with ZXing and OpenCV down to 120 px, blurred and tilted. Print it at least 2.5 cm wide, on white, with its white margin.
